import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            v %= MOD;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        ModInt() {
            val = 0;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt o) {
            val = (val + o.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt o) {
            val = (val - o.val + MOD) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt o) {
            val = (int) ((long) val * o.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        ModInt neg() {
            return val != 0 ? new ModInt(MOD - val) : new ModInt(0);
        }

        boolean equals(ModInt o) {
            return val == o.val;
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            int a = val, b = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (a > 1) {
                int q = a / b;
                int temp = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = temp;
                temp = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? new ModInt(x + MOD) : new ModInt(x);
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(1);
            ModInt a = new ModInt(this.val);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res.mul(a);
                a.mul(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        static ModInt add(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).add(b);
        }

        static ModInt sub(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).sub(b);
        }

        static ModInt mul(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).mul(b);
        }

        static ModInt div(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.val).div(b);
        }
    }

    static final int N_MAX = 10;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] prob = new ModInt[N_MAX][N_MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = ModInt.div(new ModInt(p), new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masks_with_count = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masks_with_count.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < 1 << N; mask++) {
            int cnt = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masks_with_count.get(cnt).size();
            masks_with_count.get(cnt).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possible_masks = new HashMap<>();
        possible_masks.put(1L << lookup[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> new_possible_masks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
                products[i] = new ModInt(1);
            }

            for (int cur = 0; cur < 1 << N; cur++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int r = 0; r < N; r++) {
                    if ((cur >> r & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = ModInt.mul(prod, prob[left][r]);
                    } else {
                        ModInt one = new ModInt(1);
                        ModInt probVal = prob[left][r];
                        ModInt temp = ModInt.sub(one, probVal);
                        temp = ModInt.sub(temp, one);
                        prod = ModInt.add(prod, temp);
                    }
                }
                products[cur] = prod;
            }

            long[] new_bits = new long[N];
            long[] new_possible = new long[1 << N];

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possible_masks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey();
                ModInt prob_cur = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits, 0);
                for (int mask : masks_with_count.get(left)) {
                    if ((possible >> lookup[mask] & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if ((mask >> i & 1) == 0) {
                                new_bits[i] |= 1L << lookup[mask | (1 << i)];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                new_possible[0] = 0;
                for (int cur = 1; cur < 1 << N; cur++) {
                    new_possible[cur] = new_possible[cur & (cur - 1)] | new_bits[Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(cur)];
                    long key = new_possible[cur];
                    new_possible_masks.put(key, ModInt.add(new_possible_masks.getOrDefault(key, new ModInt(0)), ModInt.mul(prob_cur, products[cur])));
                }
            }

            possible_masks = new_possible_masks;
        }

        ModInt ans = new ModInt(0);
        long full_mask = (1L << N) - 1;
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possible_masks.entrySet()) {
            if ((entry.getKey() >> lookup[(int) full_mask] & 1) == 1) {
                ans = ModInt.add(ans, entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans.val);
    }
}
